gripOrHq.title: Security Purge
gripOrHq.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

gripOrHq.title: Project Venice

heapOrArchives.title: Setup!
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

discardCards.title: Viral Pipeline
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

discardCards.title: Garbage In
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

rig.title: Vienna 22
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Vienna counter. Each Vienna counter allows you to access an additional card from HQ whenever you access cards from HQ. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Big Frackin' Gun

rig.title: The Short Circuit
